title: Adjacent-value language
statement: For Boolean values $a$ and $b$, let $L_{a,b}$ consist of the strings encoding a pair whose first component is a string of $n$ ones and whose second component is the binary representation of some integer $i$, for some $n,i\in\mathbb{N}$, such that either $i<n$ and $a$ is true, or $i=n$ and $b$ is true.
